title: ProjectIntegrity
description: Detects accidental corruption of a project file. Not authenticity: 401 section 11 is explicit that this is a checksum, not a signature, and a file that fails it is reported rather than trusted or silently repaired.

algorithm.description: The hash algorithm. A closed set, so an unknown algorithm is a rejection rather than a field nobody validates.

contentHash.description: Hash of the canonically serialized document with this field excluded, as lowercase hexadecimal (401 section 11).
